clips.title: The story
paras: Darcy packs Parker's Lunch in Lakeshire for Guard Parker's patrol. The meal offers a glimpse of the bonds and modest comforts among Redridge's defenders.

Darcy, a waitress at the Lakeshire inn, packs a meal for Guard Parker. He patrols the exposed road south toward Duskwood while Redridge faces attacks from gnolls and Blackrock orcs. The garrison is stretched thin and cut off from Stormwind's aid, leaving guards to keep long, lonely watches. Darcy's small gesture keeps Parker fed and begins a bashful courtship between the two townspeople.
